test.title: A friend you have known for a long time

document.cue: Describe a friend you have known for a long time.

text: I'd like to talk about my friend Dana, whom I've known since we were seven. We were put next to each other on the first day of school because our surnames started with the same letter, and we've been close ever since — that's almost fifteen years now.

We're quite different people. She's very organised and plans everything weeks in advance, while I tend to do things at the last minute. She's studying medicine in Karaganda now, and I'm in Almaty, so we don't see each other as often as we'd like, maybe four or five times a year.

When we do meet, we usually go for long walks and talk for hours, as if no time has passed. We also have a tradition of sending each other a voice message every Sunday evening, describing the best and worst moment of our week. Some of those messages are ten minutes long.

I think our friendship has lasted because we've always been honest with each other, even when it wasn't comfortable. When I was thinking of dropping out of university in my first year, she was the only person who told me directly that I was making a mistake, and she was right.
Friends like that are rare, so I try hard not to take her for granted.

tips.en: She plans … while I tend to … describes through difference.
tips.kk: She plans … while I tend to … — айырмашылық арқылы сипаттау.
tips.ru: She plans … while I tend to … — описание через различие.
tips.example: while I tend to do things at the last minute

tips.en: The only person who told me directly … proves honesty with an example.
tips.kk: The only person who told me directly … — «honest» сөзінің орнына адалдық мысалы.
tips.ru: The only person who told me directly … — пример честности вместо слова «honest».
tips.example: she was the only person who told me directly that I was making a mistake

note.en: Who she is and how they met — the story about their surnames.
note.kk: Кім және қалай танысты — тегі туралы оқиға.
note.ru: Кто и как познакомились — история с фамилиями.

note.en: How different they are and where they live now.
note.kk: Олар қандай әртүрлі және қазір қайда тұрады.
note.ru: Какие они разные и где живут сейчас.

note.en: What they do together — walks and Sunday voice messages.
note.kk: Бірге не істейді — серуен және жексенбілік дауыстық хабарлар.
note.ru: Что делают вместе — прогулки и воскресные голосовые.

note.en: Why the friendship has lasted — honesty and a specific moment.
note.kk: Достық неге ұзақ — адалдық және нақты оқиға.
note.ru: Почему дружба длится — честность и конкретный случай.

note.en: The ending: the value of such a friendship.
